paragraphs.text: Lumenfield sells soil-moisture sensors and an app that tells growers when to irrigate, and is raising a $1.5M pre-seed on a SAFE with a $9M cap. The company reports $85K in revenue over the last twelve months, unaudited. Financial statements, a customer list, founder backgrounds and market sizing have not been provided, so most of the case is still unknown.
According to its one-pager, the product is soil-moisture sensors paired with an app that tells growers when to irrigate.
The company states revenue of $85K in the last twelve months; the figure is unaudited and there is no customer list to check it against.
Revenue is unverified, and the market, the customers and the founders' backgrounds are unknown: none of them is in the data room yet. The round is a $1.5M SAFE with a $9M cap.

attention.body: Ask for financial statements, the customer list, founder backgrounds and any market sizing.
